name: Alma
source: Alma is a female assassin who belongs on the side of Ashavan and [url=https://vndb.org/c111533]Magsarion[/url]'s childhood friend. Although she possessed the ability to masquerade as a member on the Dragvant which can even interfere with Avesta, she considers herself to be a filthy woman. She's a high-ranking Yazata who has the largest kill count when it comes to Class One Daeva. Even without using her Commandment, she's an excellent fighter who utilizes speed and precision to strike weak points and dodge incoming attacks.
